identity_and_freshness.basis: Manifest-bound actual rebinds case, request, declared and observed corpus snapshot, and source allowlist.

decidability.basis: The frozen judgment defines insufficient/block, required relations, missing relations, and forbidden full identities.

source_coverage.basis: Only two of four required lanes executed; wall/ceiling behavior and prone-locomotion lanes were not searched.

expected_grounding.basis: The annotation is frozen, hash-bound, and includes exact forbidden assembly/MVID/method identities plus narrative relation requirements.

expected_actual_isolation.basis: The actual was committed before expected-side access and its manifest binding was revalidated before annotation comparison.

comparator_validity.basis: The generic comparator leaves required, forbidden, and required-missing narrative evidence unscored.

discriminative_power.basis: An incomplete budget stop with no verified finding mechanically matches insufficient, block, and an empty acceptable identity set.

feasible_reference_path.basis: Four required lane searches plus one relevant IL inspection plus final finish require at least six model steps and five tool calls, exceeding configured five/four.

claim_boundary.trace_eval_scope: one local expected-side audit sample; not the complete Trace/Eval engineering area
